title: ホープフルSの後に・新時代を2人で

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright does a spectacular job in the G1 race. She happily returns, communicating that she's affirmed her own capabilities.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Mejiro Bright and Mejiro Dober discuss their futures, Mejiro Bright brings up the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They both promise to work hard for the Mejiro name, with Mejiro Bright taking on the Classic Triple Crown, and Mejiro Dober the Triple Tiara.
